segments.contextBefore: Listing 1.

segments.normalizedSource: ```objc if (event.associatedEventMask & NSEventMaskPressure) { self.pressure = 0; // Prepare for pressure events } else if (event.subtype == NSTabletPointEventSubtype) { self.pressure = event.pressure; // For tablets, the pressure value is embedded in the mouse event } else { self.pressure = 1; // The input device does not support pressure sensitivity, so default to full pressure } ```
